gpt.rationale: The mostly subdued fear/surprise fits an introvert's restrained reactions, but repeated broad surprise on lines like 'This is why I'm late...?' and relief/hesitant acceptance beats flattens several distinct emotions.

claude.rationale: Sprites only ever alternate between fear and surprise, missing the introvert's subtle, restrained register (no quiet smile, downcast eyes, or hesitation), and the relief and final blooming-curiosity lines are mismatched as plain surprise/fear.
